title: Cognitive Behavioral Therapy for the Prevention of Paranoia in Adolescents at High Risk
brief_summary: The main objective of this study is to decrease the severity of symptoms and improve psycho-social functioning in youth at high risk of developing psychosis by providing a specialized Group-and-Family-based Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (GF-CBT).
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* meets criteria for ARMS (at Risk Mental State, assessed by CAARMS)
* Elevated suspiciousness (PANSS,P6≥3)

Exclusion Criteria:

A diagnosis of any of the following:

* Moderate to severe learning disability
* Substance dependence
* Organic impairment known to affect brain
